instance_id.description: Unique identifier for this instance; used in logs and monitoring.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging; recommended 'info' for production.

enabled.description: Expose metrics for scraping by Prometheus or compatible systems.

endpoint.description: Path prefix for the metrics endpoint.

port.description: Port to listen on for metrics endpoints.

pid_file.description: Path to the file storing the main process PID.

config.description: Backend-specific key-value parameters (e.g., host, port, password).

type.description: Queue backend type: 'memory' (for dev/test only), 'redis', or 'postgres'.

server.description: Network and connection settings for the main listener.

bind_host.description: Network interface to bind (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::', or '0.0.0.0' for all).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

server_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate chain file (required if TLS is enabled).

server_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for all incoming connections.

worker.description: Worker process tuning and resource limits.

graceful_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight jobs to complete during shutdown before force-terminating.

max_jobs_per_worker.description: Maximum jobs a worker processes before it is recycled for stability.

memory_limit_mb.description: Maximum memory (in MB) a worker is allowed before forced restart (0 = unlimited).

process_count.description: Number of worker processes (0 means auto-detect based on CPU cores).

working_dir.description: Base directory for runtime data, temp files, and job storage.
